lines.en: I walk to the drumbeat.
My mask is heavy; I walk slowly.
I follow the jungle trail.
My staff taps the ground.
I chant as I walk.
My bone charms rattle.
I slip around those vines.
I head toward the noise.
Every three steps, my staff strikes.
No one knows these paths better.
I press a line through the grass.
My shadow moves with the drum.
I climb high before casting.
No rush; spells take time.
I carry the smell of herbs.
I shift my steps your way.
I am shaking a rattle in my hand.

lines.zh: 我站着念一段没人听懂的话
lines.en: I stand chanting words no one knows.
My mask faces forward.
I wait for someone to come near.
My fingers are calculating.
There is smoke in the air.
I check the marks on the tree.

lines.zh: 我不用看你也知道你在
lines.en: I know you are there without looking.
I am polishing my staff's head.

lines.zh: 丛林的声音我听得很清楚
lines.en: I hear the jungle clearly.
I stand still; my shadow moves.
You have entered my ground.
I look at you through the mask.
I cannot tell if you are afraid.
You carry no mark.
I know your footprints.

lines.zh: 丛林的吊坠，在我脖子上响。
lines.en: The jungle pendant clinks at my neck.

lines.zh: 我的面具没有眼睛，但看得见
lines.en: My mask has no eyes, yet sees.
Your shadow is slightly off.
Do you want a charm too?
I am counting your bones.
One of my bone charms broke.
I stepped back; my mask stayed straight.
That broke my chant.
I pressed a hand to my chest.
I do not shout; it would waste breath.
My staff nearly slipped.
I can brew a remedy for this.
You broke the ritual's rhythm.
I will remember you.
Herbs cannot hide the smell of blood.
Is this offered to me?

lines.zh: 我不缺吃的，缺的是材料
lines.en: I lack ingredients, not food.
Place it on the stone slab.
I accept the gesture.
This can go into a draught.
I do not eat it; I brew it.

lines.zh: 吊坠一晃，我的咒就到了。
lines.en: One swing of my pendant, and the curse lands.
Let me smell it first.
Good scent, too little.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，再退两步
lines.en: Set it down and step back two paces.
You hit my bone charms.
I gave half a step; my mask stayed straight.
My staff came between us.
You were pushed back a little.
My ornaments are fragile.

lines.zh: 碰撞惊动了林子里的小东西
lines.en: The bump startled the forest.
Nothing broke between us.
You stepped on my herb pouch.
Step back; I need these.
Remember to take another path.

lines.zh: 面具后面的人不谈这个
lines.en: The one behind the mask does not speak of this.
My companions are these drums.
A witch doctor's path is narrow.
That is an unlucky question.
I gave my life to the jungle.
Ask the drums about that.
I shake my head; the mask sways.
Not in a place like this.
We are unsuited: a person and a witch doctor.
Go; night is coming.
This fell by the altar.
Let me check it for curses.
I tuck it into my pouch.
Yours; keep it.
There is mud on it.
No need to bend; my staff reaches.
I could use this.
Dropping things is a bad omen.
Be more careful next time.
I have caught sight of you.
I have already raised my staff.
This forest listens to me.
I have spoken the first line.
No need to run; the spell is quick.
The drums will tell you.
I know the tree behind you.
I choose you, no other.
Your breathing has lost its rhythm.
This is the forest's will.
It will be over quickly.
I move to the drum.

lines.zh: 你踩断的树枝我听见了
lines.en: I heard the branch you broke.
I circle round to your flank.
The jungle tells me where you are.
Hiding behind a tree changes nothing.
My staff's tip stays on you.
I scattered a handful of powder.
Do you hear the bells?
I need not chase; the forest blocks you.
You are going in circles.
I am overhead.
My staff comes down.
This blow carries a curse.
My strikes were never quick.
My staff is heavier than you think.
You can block wood, not a curse.
I strike by your feet.
I have finished the line.
Your skin prickles.
I step back and keep chanting.
The drums sound first.
This jungle knows me.
My mask glows in the dark.
I stand on the trail, staff raised.
I was here before you came.
Smoke rises from the ground.
A shadow joined the forest.

lines.zh: 我听见你的脚步就来了
lines.en: I came when I heard your steps.
This area is under my care.
Flames licked my mask.
I fell and my charms scattered.
Water washed away my powders.
The blast cracked my drum.
An arrow pierced my plumes.

lines.zh: 术法反噬到我自己身上
lines.en: The spell rebounded onto me.
I was brewing and forgot to eat.
Lightning struck my raised staff.

lines.zh: 这里没有能借力的林子
lines.en: There is no forest here to draw on.
